info.title: Happy scoped automation control
info.description: Scoped signed REST with optional owner-approved service bearer tokens and explicit multi-project service scopes. tasks.create accepts owner-allowlisted launch options (agent/model/permissionMode/effort) discovered via /options. Worker modelSource=machine follows the live Happy Claude/Codex/Agy directory; explicit grant subsets still narrow it and permission modes remain separately allowlisted. /projects exposes only the current grant project scope. HTTP MCP OAuth and relay authentication are unchanged; service bearers do not authenticate MCP, owner or worker endpoints.

delete.description: Owner-only permanent deletion of a pending, approved, expired or revoked connection. First durably revokes access and settles its waiting jobs, then removes its service-token digest and connection record. Intents, tasks, sessions and journals are retained; running tasks are not claimed to stop.

No credentials. Disabled by default.

post.description: Same-origin owner only. Read-only outbound worker realpath/directory check inside explicit roots on both sides; returns frozen canonical projects and a non-credential selectionID valid for 120 seconds, usable once by this owner/client/worker. Does not create grant/tasks or change configuration. Roots themselves, traversal, missing/files and symlink escape denied.

202.description: Mutation outcome uncertain: query the SAME requestID; no automatic redispatch.

post.description: Optional service-token-v1: pending consent, at most 30 days from creation. Supply exactly one of expiresInMs (positive integer duration in milliseconds, resolved using server time) or legacy expiresAt (absolute timestamp in milliseconds). Both obey the configured service grant limit. Legacy projectID or explicit scopeVersion=2 + 2..32 unique projectIDs (never both). Binds every selected ID/directory, one worker/machine, shared methods/expiry, new sessions by default. V3 accepts 1..32 exact projects/projectIDs only with a fresh owner/client/worker-bound one-use selectionID returned by resolve-directories. Separate bound approval required; existing grants never expand.

post.description: tasks.create; one explicit projectID selected from this grant, creates empty dedicated session. Optional options {agent,model,permissionMode,effort} select launch overrides; every override must be inside the worker allowlist AND this grant’s approved options subset (else OPTION_DENIED). Omit options for the worker defaults. Send text separately with another stable requestID. Idempotency remains grant-wide: reusing one requestID for a different selected project or different options conflicts.

get.description: options.list; discover selectable launch options for the grant-bound machine. Returns defaultAgent plus per-agent models/permissionModes/efforts (keys) already narrowed to this grant, with defaultModel/defaultPermissionMode/defaultEffort. Empty lists mean defaults only. Requires a worker/daemon with the options capability; older workers answer UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

ClientProof.name: Authorization
ClientProof.description: Ed25519 signedHeaders helper: actor/client ID, grant ID, timestamp, nonce, method, exact path/query and canonical JSON hash. Private key comes from a platform secret provider, never a tool argument.

WorkerProof.name: Authorization
WorkerProof.description: Same proof format, worker actor and pinned worker public key.

ServiceBearer.description: Optional hsvc1 credential supplied from a backend secret store. Bound to one approved service/client/user/grant and original expiry, at most 30 days; no account secret. Never accepted on owner, enrollment, worker or MCP OAuth endpoints.

OwnerBearer.description: Existing Happy owner authentication used transiently for consent only. Origin or same-origin Fetch Metadata required; cookies do not authenticate.
